title: The Theology of Holiness
author: Dougan Clark

authorInfo.bio: Dougan Clark (1828–1896) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "The Theology of Holiness" by Dougan Clark is a theological work written in the late 19th century that explores the concept of entire sanctification from a Christian perspective. The book aims to elucidate the necessity, attainability, and implications of achieving holiness in one’s spiritual journey, based on Biblically revealed truths.
